attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: A boolean indicating the disable state of the button. The `aria-disabled` attribute relies on this property.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description:
It allows to render the chosen icon.

The icon render only if `iconName` and `iconPosition` are defined.

attributes.name: icon-library
attributes.description: The name of the icon library used by the button icons.

attributes.name: icon-name
attributes.description:
The name of the icon library used by the button icon. Defaults to 'orchestra-icons'.
Consumers can override this when they register another icon library.

The icon render only if `iconName` and `iconPosition` are defined.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: A string indicating the size variation of the button.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: This is the text which appear inside the button. It is required.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: A string indicating the behavior of the button. It relies on `HTMLButtonElement['type']`

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: A string indicating the design variation of the button based on the level of importance.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description:
A boolean indicating the indeterminate state of the checkbox (shows a dash/minus sign).
This is part of the native HTML checkbox API for mixed/partial selection states.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Optional visible label text displayed next to the checkbox.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the checkbox for form submission.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: A boolean indicating whether the field is required.

attributes.name: validation-message
attributes.description: Optional custom validity message. When set to a non-empty string, the field is invalid.

attributes.name: value
